title: MrCody's Border's
description: MrCody's Borders is a client-side mod that lets you draw, name, and color territory borders directly on Xaero's World Map.
body:
Paint chunks with three drawing modes Chunk, Brush (3x3), and Lasso or erase mistakes with the eraser tool.

Customize each border with 9 preset colors or the full HSV color picker. Give your territories meaningful names up to 64 characters long.


As you explore, the mod alerts you when you enter or leave a territory via action bar or chat messages.

All borders persist per-world and per-dimension in a simple JSON file.

No server-side installation needed just drop it in your mods folder alongside Xaero's Minimap and Xaero's World Map. 

**Inspired by the mod Border Limit Xaero's made by Author: nertin0.**

**I do NOT want too copy nertin0's work so plz visit nertin0's Mod too!**

**It is still in development**
- MrCody
